exercises.passage: Last weekend my family went to the beach. The weather was hot. First we walked on the beach. Then my brother and I played football. My mother cooked fish, and we ate dinner on the beach. At night we were very tired. We didn't watch TV. We went to sleep. It was a good weekend!
exercises.question: Where did the family go?
exercises.explain_he: בטקסט כתוב: my family went to the beach.
